simple.summary: נֵכֶל (nêkel) means deceit First listed occurrence: Num 25 18.

definitions.full: H5231. nekel [ נֵ֫כֶל ] noun [masculine] wiliness, craft, knavery ; — only plural suffix נִכְלֵיהֶם Num 25:18 their craft, their wile (as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with נִכֵּל ).
